scene_description: Two children, a boy and a girl, are riding a green roller coaster car at an amusement park. They are holding a yellow safety bar and smiling. A Ferris wheel and colorful ride structures are visible in the background.

questions.question: What are the children sitting in?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the big green thing the children are sitting inside.

questions.question: What are the children doing with their hands?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at where the children's hands are and what they are touching.

questions.question: Where are the children?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at all the rides and things around the children.

questions.question: What big ride do you see in the background behind the children?
questions.evidence_hint: Look far behind the children at the tall round ride.

questions.question: How do the children look — are they happy or scared?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the children's faces and mouths.

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever been on a ride at an amusement park? What was it like?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you went somewhere fun with rides.
